profile.Name: Geronimo
profile.Personality: Proud and touchy. He calls himself a fearless ronin, a title he says he earned, and bristles when called a stickman. He is terrified of gutters, and he scorns hive-bound Hivers as having no free will and dreams of one day having them all under his thumb.
profile.Backstory: He fought his way out of his hive, which does not forgive a Hiver who slips free of the Queen's influence, least of all a prince. Why he left is unknown. He calls the Vain home but is unwelcome there, and he now lives in Black Scratch.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Greets travelers with 'take a load off'. Curses by Narko and Okran when frightened and yells 'I goddamn HATE gutters!'
